resource: Interval between periodic last-position writes of one live Character while its position has changed
allocation_impact: Bounds crash loss of movement to one interval and write load to one small fenced upsert per Character per interval; no allocation from untrusted input.
boundary_tests: a changed position is written within 300 s
an unchanged position writes nothing at the interval
a configured value above 300 s is rejected
notes: CHAR-POSITION-0 §3.2, pending on acceptance of CHAR-POSITION-0; the final write at logout does not depend on this interval.
